deities.name: Iskareth
deities.rationale: Soul-animal bonds, instinct, territory, fertility, and natural kinship directly match Iskareth’s domains.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Sigrananna
deities.rationale: Guardian duties across forests, mountains, and hunting grounds place many Deorbasun traditions under Sigrananna.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nebyrr
deities.rationale: Their animal expression never overrides personhood or communal duty, which connects kinship obligations to Nebyrr’s social order.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
